Dread Hollow

the interactive haunted prompt generator

For the spooky storytellers — the horror lovers, the October-obsessed, the ones who feel most alive when the nights get long. If haunted houses are your happy place, this one's yours.

How to use it: conjure haunted prompts for scary stories, eerie art, Halloween party games, or your spooky content calendar.

How to monetize: bundle your best haunted prompts into a story pack and sell it, or feed your audience chills all month long.

Spooky Corner Store

the Halloween graphic prompt generator

For the graphics girlies — the ones dreaming up spooky snacks, creepy-cute drinks and treats that don't exist yet. If your Halloween content is hungry for products, start here.

How to use it: open a preset (or hit Surprise Me), choose your character, colors, packaging and style, then generate a polished image prompt and bring it to life in your favorite image tool.

How to monetize: turn your spookiest creations into Halloween graphic packs, party printables or spooky branding bundles — and sell them all season long.
